items.stem: Which TWO are good state-management practices? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Use a remote backend with state locking for teams
options.rationale: Correct: remote state with locking prevents concurrent corruption.

options.text: Keep state out of plain version control because it can hold secrets
options.rationale: Correct: state may contain sensitive values.

options.text: Email the state file around to share it
options.rationale: That leaks secrets and causes drift.

options.text: Edit state by hand as the normal workflow
options.rationale: Manual edits are error-prone and avoided.

items.explanation: Correct: remote state with locking prevents concurrent corruption.
